# ART Mechatronics

> Manufacturer of industrial processing, packaging, material-handling and dust-collection
> machinery — single machines through to complete PLC-controlled turnkey lines. Based in
> India, serving India, the UAE and Thailand. Next-generation automation backed by
> Thermocare manufacturing experience since 1997.

ART Mechatronics designs, manufactures, installs and commissions equipment for food
processing, spices and seasoning, pan masala and mouth freshener, pharmaceuticals,
chemicals, agro processing, plastics and allied industries. Machines are
custom-engineered to the customer's product, capacity and plant layout rather than
sold from a fixed catalogue.

Contact: info@artmechatronics.com · India +91 80903 15151 · UAE +971 50 216 7151 ·
Thailand +66 838291089

Note on imagery: product photographs on this site are disclosed representative
renders, not photographs of the specific unit supplied. Specifications are engineered
per order — confirm capacities and materials with the company directly.
